C1433.title: Solana Network Outage Caused by Spam Transaction Attack
C1433.summary: In September 2024, the Solana network experienced a spam transaction attack that flooded validators' voting mechanism with excessive traffic, preventing block finalization and causing an outage of approximately 4.5 hours.
